items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: They had two of us playing, August and myself, you know.

ctx.x: They had two of us playing, August and myself, you know. Yeah. And he used to like me to be right behind me and say, come on, because you push me when I'm playing. Yeah. Yeah, he was a good son. Tell me he's got a couple of sons that are good musicians.
I only know Ralph, and he plays Reeds too.
